facts.value: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent degree in Art History, Philosophy, Ethnology, History, Art Education, Archaeological Sciences, or related cultural studies subjects.
Proof of knowledge of two foreign languages: English at level B2 and a second modern foreign language at level B1.
For admission to the master's examination at the end of the program, proof of Latin knowledge or a third modern foreign language at level B1 is required.
International students need to provide proof of language proficiency at the DSH-1 level.
